steps.title: It shows a shift
steps.say: That green arrow is a shift arrow: it shows the whole demand curve moving, not a move along it.

ops.text: Green arrow = the demand curve shifting right

steps.title: Old to new
steps.say: It points from the old curve D1 to the new curve D2, because buyers now want more at every price.

ops.text: D1 → D2: more wanted at every price

steps.title: Not a price move
steps.say: Do not confuse it with sliding along a curve, which is just a price change.

ops.text:
Shift ≠ slide along
the same curve
